train_grid: resampled Gauss family, redrawn every 250 iterations
control_condition: arm (b) trained on the audit grid itself, so the resampling effect is a measured contrast rather than an assumption
gate: max relative change between consecutive audit-grid snapshots over the final 10 %, below tau; the training objective is not read because resampling makes it jump
node_note: arms are independent sequential-deflation runs and both nodes report the same python/numpy/scipy/torch versions, so splitting them does not change a result; dgx01 was stopped after its two arms to avoid recomputing what dgx02 had, which is why only dgx02 wrote a driver manifest and this one was merged by hand
primary_result: mechanism reproduced in 3D: (a) diagonal 0/60 correct with 58/60 lower-mode basin over modes 4-6, against 16/60 with 3/60 basin for the exact projection and 23/60 with 2/60 for QR; the diagonal-exact and diagonal-QR Wilson intervals are disjoint
control_result: the only two Rayleigh-lower-bound violations in the 480-cell grid are in the fixed-grid condition, at margins -0.898 and -0.737 with check grid drift up to 1.1e6, on a grid certified to 1.2e-12; the higher p_correct of that condition is not a held-out measurement and also differs in training resolution, so it is not read as the fixed grid being better
